source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Current SecondaryCompare compares message keys directly when already in secondary recursion or when secondary sort is byId, respecting the secondary ascending direction. The kU32 branch can then fetch fields without a redundant byId branch. Entry 737 removes that dead branch. Preserve the early return and isSecondarySort context flag when changing tie-break behavior; it prevents recursion and explains why the generic branch cannot handle byId.
title: Keep the SecondaryCompare byId early return ahead of generic field lookup
